summary: The 2007 Larson/Boswell/Kanold/Stiff Algebra 1, with 13 chapters and lessons titled as tasks ('Solve...', 'Graph...', 'Write...'). It runs from expressions, real numbers, and linear equations through graphing and writing linear equations, inequalities, systems, exponents, polynomials and factoring, and quadratics, then radicals, rational functions, and probability and data analysis.

toc.label: Chapter 1
toc.title: Expressions, Equations, and Functions
toc.covers: Evaluating and writing expressions, equations, and inequalities, a problem-solving plan, and functions as rules, tables, and graphs.

children.title: Evaluate Algebraic Expressions
children.covers: Evaluating variable expressions and powers by substitution.

children.title: Apply Order of Operations
children.covers: Using the order of operations, including grouping symbols and exponents.

children.title: Write Expressions
children.covers: Translating verbal phrases into algebraic expressions, including rates and units.

children.title: Write Equations and Inequalities
children.covers: Translating sentences into equations and inequalities and checking solutions.

children.title: Using a Problem Solving Plan
children.covers: A read, plan, solve, check method for word problems.

children.title: Represent Functions as Rules and Tables
children.covers: Domain, range, and function rules shown in input-output tables.

children.title: Represent Functions as Graphs
children.covers: Graphing functions from tables and rules and reading graphs.

toc.label: Chapter 2
toc.title: Properties of Real Numbers
toc.covers: Integers and rational numbers, the four operations on real numbers, the distributive property, and square roots.

children.title: Properties of Real Numbers
children.covers: Classifying real numbers, opposites, and absolute value.

children.title: Add Real Numbers
children.covers: Adding real numbers and the properties of addition.

children.title: Subtract Real Numbers
children.covers: Subtracting real numbers by adding the opposite.

children.title: Multiply Real Numbers
children.covers: Multiplying real numbers, sign rules, and properties of multiplication.

children.title: Apply the Distributive Property
children.covers: Distributing and combining like terms to simplify expressions.

children.title: Divide Real Numbers
children.covers: Dividing real numbers with reciprocals and the sign rules.

children.title: Find Square Roots and Compare Real Numbers
children.covers: Square roots, irrational numbers, and ordering real numbers.

toc.label: Chapter 3
toc.title: Solving Linear Equations
toc.covers: One-step through multi-step linear equations, ratios and proportions, percent problems, and literal equations.

children.title: Solve One-Step Equations
children.covers: Solving equations with one inverse operation.

children.title: Solve Two-Step Equations
children.covers: Solving equations that need two inverse operations.

children.title: Solve Multi-Step Equations
children.covers: Solving equations that need distributing and combining like terms.

children.title: Solve Equations with Variables on Both Sides
children.covers: Collecting variables on one side and spotting identities and no-solution equations.

children.title: Write Ratios and Proportions
children.covers: Writing ratios and solving proportions with multiplication.

children.title: Write and Solve Ratios and Proportions
children.covers: Solving proportions with cross products, including scale drawings.

children.title: Solve Percent Problems
children.covers: Using the percent equation to find a part, a whole, or a percent.

children.title: Rewrite Equations and Formulas
children.covers: Solving literal equations and formulas for a given variable.

toc.label: Chapter 4
toc.title: Graphing Linear Equations and Functions
toc.covers: The coordinate plane, graphing lines from tables, intercepts, and slope-intercept form, slope and rate of change, direct variation, and function notation.

children.title: Plot Points in a Coordinate Plane
children.covers: Plotting points and identifying quadrants.

children.title: Graph Linear Equations
children.covers: Graphing linear equations from a table of values, including horizontal and vertical lines.

children.title: Graph Lines Using x and y Intercepts
children.covers: Finding intercepts and using them to graph a line.

children.title: Slope and Rate of Change
children.covers: Computing slope from two points and interpreting it as a rate of change.

children.title: Graph Using Slope-Intercept Form
children.covers: Graphing y = mx + b and recognizing parallel lines.

children.title: Model Direct Variation
children.covers: Writing and graphing direct variation equations y = ax.

children.title: Graph Linear Functions
children.covers: Function notation f(x) and graphing linear functions and families of functions.

toc.label: Chapter 5
toc.title: Writing Linear Equations
toc.covers: Writing equations of lines in slope-intercept, point-slope, and standard form, parallel and perpendicular lines, and linear models from data.

children.title: Write Linear Equations in Slope-Intercept Form
children.covers: Writing y = mx + b from a slope and intercept or from a graph.

children.title: Use Equations in Slope-Intercept Form
children.covers: Writing slope-intercept equations from a point and slope or from two points.

children.title: Write Linear Equations in Point-Slope Form
children.covers: Writing and graphing equations in point-slope form.

children.title: Write Linear Equations in Standard Form
children.covers: Writing and converting equations to Ax + By = C.

children.title: Write Equations of Parallel and Perpendicular Lines
children.covers: Using equal and opposite-reciprocal slopes to write equations.

children.title: Fit a Line to Data
children.covers: Scatter plots, correlation, and drawing a line of fit.

children.title: Predict with Linear Models
children.covers: Using lines of fit for interpolation and extrapolation, including best-fit lines.

toc.label: Chapter 6
toc.title: Solving and Graphing Linear Inequalities
toc.covers: One-step, multi-step, compound, and absolute value inequalities, absolute value equations, and inequalities in two variables.

children.title: Solve Inequalities Using Addition and Subtraction
children.covers: Solving and graphing one-step inequalities with addition or subtraction.

children.title: Solve Inequalities Using Multiplication and Division
children.covers: Solving inequalities and reversing the sign when multiplying or dividing by a negative.

children.title: Solve Multi-Step Inequalities
children.covers: Solving inequalities that take several steps.

children.title: Solve Compound Inequalities
children.covers: Solving and graphing 'and' and 'or' inequalities.

children.title: Solve Absolute Value Equations
children.covers: Solving equations with absolute value by splitting into two cases.

children.title: Solve Absolute Value Inequalities
children.covers: Rewriting absolute value inequalities as compound inequalities.

children.title: Graph Linear Inequalities in Two Variables
children.covers: Graphing half-planes with boundary lines and test points.

toc.label: Chapter 7
toc.title: Systems of Equations and Inequalities
toc.covers: Solving linear systems by graphing, substitution, and elimination, special systems, and systems of inequalities.

children.title: Solve Linear Systems by Graphing
children.covers: Finding the intersection of two lines by graphing.

children.title: Solving Systems of Equations by Substitution
children.covers: Solving a system by substituting one equation into the other.

children.title: Solve Linear Systems by Adding or Subtracting
children.covers: Eliminating a variable by adding or subtracting the equations.

children.title: Solving Systems of Equations by Multiplying (Elimination)
children.covers: Multiplying one or both equations before eliminating a variable.

children.title: Solve Special Types of Linear Systems
children.covers: Recognizing systems with no solution or infinitely many solutions.

children.title: Solve Systems of Linear Inequalities
children.covers: Graphing systems of inequalities and identifying the solution region.

toc.label: Chapter 8
toc.title: Exponents and Exponential Functions
toc.covers: Exponent properties, zero and negative exponents, scientific notation, and exponential growth and decay.

children.title: Apply Exponent Properties Involving Products
children.covers: Product of powers, power of a power, and power of a product.

children.title: Apply Exponent Properties Involving Quotients
children.covers: Quotient of powers and power of a quotient.

children.title: Zero and Negative Exponents
children.covers: Defining and simplifying with zero and negative exponents.

children.title: Scientific Notation
children.covers: Writing and computing with numbers in scientific notation.

children.title: Write and Graph Exponential Growth Functions
children.covers: Modeling growth with y = a(1 + r)^t and graphing it.

children.title: Write and Graph Exponential Decay Functions
children.covers: Modeling decay with y = a(1 - r)^t and graphing it.

toc.label: Chapter 9
toc.title: Polynomials and Factoring
toc.covers: Polynomial operations, special products, and factoring by GCF, trinomial patterns, special products, and grouping to solve equations.

children.title: Add and Subtract Polynomials
children.covers: Classifying polynomials and adding and subtracting them.

children.title: Multiply Polynomials
children.covers: Multiplying polynomials with distribution, tables, and FOIL.

children.title: Special Products
children.covers: Square-of-a-binomial and sum-and-difference patterns.

children.title: Solve Polynomial Equations in Factored Form
children.covers: Using the zero-product property and factoring out a GCF to solve equations.

children.title: Factor x^2 + bx + c
children.covers: Factoring trinomials with leading coefficient 1 and solving the equations.

children.title: Factor ax^2 + bx + c
children.covers: Factoring trinomials with leading coefficient other than 1.

children.title: Factor Special Products
children.covers: Factoring differences of squares and perfect square trinomials.

children.title: Factor Polynomials Completely
children.covers: Factoring by grouping and factoring completely.

toc.label: Chapter 10
toc.title: Quadratic Equations and Functions
toc.covers: Graphing parabolas and solving quadratic equations by graphing, square roots, completing the square, and the quadratic formula.

children.title: Graph y = ax^2 + c
children.covers: Graphing simple parabolas and describing stretches and shifts.

children.title: Graph y = ax^2 + bx + c
children.covers: Finding the axis of symmetry and vertex and graphing general quadratics.

children.title: Solve Quadratic Equations by Graphing
children.covers: Reading solutions as x-intercepts of a parabola.

children.title: Solve Quadratic Equations Using Square Roots
children.covers: Solving ax^2 + c = 0 by taking square roots.

children.title: Solve Quadratic Equations by Completing the Square
children.covers: Completing the square to solve quadratics.

children.title: Solve Quadratic Equations by the Quadratic Formula
children.covers: Using the quadratic formula.

children.title: Interpret the Discriminant
children.covers: Using the discriminant to count real solutions.

toc.label: Chapter 11
toc.title: Radicals and Geometry Connections
toc.covers: Square-root functions, simplifying radicals, the Pythagorean Theorem, and the distance and midpoint formulas.

children.title: Graph Square Root Functions
children.covers: Graphing y = a√x and its translations and finding domain and range.

children.title: Simplify Radical Expressions
children.covers: Simplifying radicals, rationalizing denominators, and radical arithmetic.

children.title: Apply the Pythagorean Theorem and Its Converse
children.covers: Finding right-triangle side lengths and testing for right triangles.

children.title: Apply the Distance and Midpoint Formulas
children.covers: Finding distances and midpoints on the coordinate plane.

toc.label: Chapter 12
toc.title: Rational Equations and Functions
toc.covers: Inverse variation, rational functions, and polynomial division; the later lessons on rational expressions and equations were not found.

children.title: Model Inverse Variation
children.covers: Writing and graphing inverse variation equations y = a/x.

children.title: Graph Rational Functions
children.covers: Graphing rational functions and their asymptotes.

children.title: Divide Polynomials
children.covers: Dividing polynomials by monomials and binomials.

toc.label: Chapter 13
toc.title: Probability and Data Analysis
toc.covers: Counting, probability, and data displays and statistics; no lesson list was found.

notes: Partial lesson coverage: no source fetched gave the whole table of contents. Chapter titles join the archived ClassZone chapter list, which cuts titles at 30 characters (full only for Chapters 1, 3, and 9), with the Lumos list, which prints all 13 but writes '&' for 'and' (Lumos says 'Systems of Linear Equations & Inequalities' for Chapter 7; ClassZone's 'Systems of Equations an...' was followed). Lesson titles from the ExploreLearning 2007 correlation are exact: 1.2-1.4, 1.6-1.7, 2.2, 2.7, 3.1-3.2, 3.5, 3.7-3.8, 4.1-4.2, 4.5-4.7, 5.1, 5.3-5.4, 5.6-5.7, 6.1-6.2, 6.4, 6.6-6.7, 7.1, 7.3, 7.5-7.6, 8.1-8.2, 8.5-8.6, 9.1, 9.4-9.7, 10.1-10.3, 10.6, 11.1-11.2, 11.4-11.5, and 12.1-12.3. All other lesson titles are in a Medfield teacher's own wording and may differ from the book. The likeliest mismatches: 2.1 (topic is integers and rational numbers, not properties), 3.6 (the teacher repeated 3.5's label), 4.3, 4.4, 7.2, and 7.4. Missing lessons: 11.3, 12.4 onward, all of Chapter 13, and any 8.7, 9.9, or 10.8. The Medfield page numbers (for example 7.1 on pp. 430-433) fit the 2007 national edition. Of the work-list ISBNs, Open Library lists 9780618595563 as the Teacher's Edition; 9780618887637 and 9780618887743 could not be resolved to a specific printing. Descriptions are from general knowledge of the topics.
